notes.title: Patch Notes: May 29 2025
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We just debuted a new trailer (you can find it in the gallery!) and to go with it we have prepared a small update to the demo.

Nothing too big if you have already played it, but there are some important things that we wanted to patch in there!


[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a Credits and Licenses section.
[*] Added an additional red highlight to Aline when doing a dodge with perfect timing.
[*] Small UI animation improvements.
[*] Changed all instances of “Ground Game Atelier” branding to “Ground” (More info on this in a future blog post).
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed various minor issues (performance, localization, gameplay, etc).
[*] Fixed several Japanese translation errors.
[/list]

Your old saves should work as before without issue, but let us know if you encounter any problems in this new version!

Sincerely,

[b]Yite/b]

notes.title: Demo Update: Added Japanese localization!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Nitro here. We've got another patch incoming!

The  [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ground/the-time-i-have-left?ref=39jk4s][b]Kickstarter campaign has about a week left[/b][/url], and we still need your help to reach our goal. We encourage you to check it out and share it with your friends! And your enemies too, while we're at it.

The big news in this patch is that we're adding a new localization to the demo: Japanese! You can switch languages in the Options menu.

Now, onto the changelog:


[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added the Japanese localization.
[*] Some UI elements now have an automatic scroll when their text is too long to fit.
[/list]

[h1]Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] The melee attacks for Enemy 3 (the one with the spikes!) now consume much more of the creature's Willpower to compensate for them being so difficult to avoid.
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Map App no longer freezes if you open the Quick Navigation menu while there are no named locations to quick-navigate.
[*] Fixed various minor issues (performance, localization, etc).
[/list]

Sincerely,

[b]Nitro and the team at Ground Game Atelier[/b]

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Nitro here. The [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ground/the-time-i-have-left?ref=39jk4s][b]Kickstarter campaign is still ongoing[/b][/url], and [b]we'd love your support in sharing it![/b] In the meantime, [b]we've got a patch for the demo[/b].

We've been reading everyone's feedback and, after some consideration, we've decided to offer additional options to tweak the difficulty of combat while playing in the "Story Play style".

These tweaks [b]are optional:[/b] You can unequip the associated Passive Skills to completely disable them if you wish, making it so the only difference between the different Play style Modes is how the timer is treated.

Bear in mind that to receive the new skills in Story Mode[b] you will need to start a new game[/b] (do not load a previous save).

[h1]Story Play style:[/h1]

* The passive Skill "Reflexes" now increases the size of QTE success areas (e.g. when you attempt to kick down a pillar).

* Added two new Passive Skill
[olist]
[*] [b]Perception:[/b] briefly slows down enemy attacks when they're close to hitting you.
[*] [b]Polyvalence:[/b] allows you to dodge any attack by pressing any directional button.
[/olist]
* The Passive Skills "Perception" and "Polyvalence" are now unlocked by default in Story Mode. Only "Reflexes" and "Perception" are equipped by default. You can unequip or reset them in the Skills Menu.

[h1]Balance:[/h1]

* Enemy AI has been slightly adjusted. Enemies are now much less likely to Accumulate SP and Cast during the same turn, and the boss won't restore its own WP as often during the second phase.

* The defensive Skill 'Breathing 𝛼' now restores additional WP.

* The command 'Focus' restores additional Tension.

* Reduced the effect of the command Skill "Focus 𝛼" (boosts the Tension gained by 'Focus').

[h1]General:[/h1]

* The "App Menu" shortcut (Q on the keyboard, L2/LT on the controller) now instead opens the map.

* A variety of UI and localization errors have been fixed.

We hope you're enjoying [i]The Time I Have Left[/i] so far! And if you haven't had a chance to try it out, please feel free to do so! [b]Your feedback will be much appreciated.[/b]

Sincerely,

[b]Nitro and the team at Ground Game Atelier[/b]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo: 04/10/2022 Patch
notes.notes:
Happy Steam Next Fest, everybody!

Thank you so much for your time and support! So many people have tried the demo for The Time I Have Left, and we couldn't be more grateful.

We have a small patch with a few fixes. Here it is!

[list]
[*] Pausing during NDE intro, flee, victory, and defeat sequences is no longer possible. This should prevent perceived soft locks (the game wasn't locked, it's just that the pause screen would be faded out along the rest of the HUD!)
[*] Fix a bug that prevents you from loading your automatic save if no manual save is present.
[*] corrected a few typos and cleaned up some localization errors.
[*] Fixed an issue where the sprint meter would no longer be visible after specific cutscenes.
[*] Starting a new game no longer clears your previous save. Reaching a Waiting Room will still overwrite them.
[*] The options menu now closes with enter/start instead of the cancel button.
[*] The gamepad hint on the pause menu no longer swaps the position of the cancel and accept buttons.
[/list]
